text:
mira_ml: bringing up radon11b int4 warmstart on canary. hitting sporadic OOMs on small batch sizes. posting quick logs + config. any ideas?

mira_ml: ```
model: radon11b
quant: int4
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 4
  max_new_tokens: 128
  prefetch_kv: true
kv:
  warmup_entries: 64
  trim_ratio: 0.3
soft_throttle:
  enabled: false
``` 

sam_infra: saw OOMs in node ml-canary-3, mem spike during kv warmup. can you paste dmesg + allocator logs?

mira_ml: dmesg snippet:
```
[12345.678] oom_reaper: reaped process 4123 (python) total-vm: 512000kB, anon-rss: 384000kB
[12345.679] Out of memory: Killed process 4123 (runtimed) total-vm: 512000kB, anon-rss: 384000kB
```
allocator log:
```
alloc failed: requested 48MB, available 12MB
kv_warmup: allocated 64 entries, cur_mem=3.8GB, baseline=3.2GB
``` 

alex_dev: try lowering `warmup_entries` to 16 and enable `kv_shrink_on_coldstart: true`. also reduce prefetch_kv to false for canary. soft-throttle early helps. example patch:
```
warmup_entries: 16
prefetch_kv: false
kv_shrink_on_coldstart: true
batcher:
  max_new_tokens: 96
  max_batch_size: 3
``` 

tony_research: fwiw we should run the int4 eval sweep before/after to check quality regression. I'll run 200 prompts. @cora_eval can you share quick eval harness results from the earlier run?

cora_eval: ran a 50-prompt smoke on canary int4 vs fp16 (same seed). short results: ppl up ~2.2%, EM down 1.8% on our NLU set. examples show minor tokenization drift. attaching a couple cases:
- fp16: "Confirm schedule for 3pm"
- int4: "Confirming schedule 3pm" (missing preposition in a couple outputs)

mira_ml: applied alex's patch (hash: a1b2c3d), started new canary at 3951236796. deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for radon11b-int4 on pool canary-ml-3.

deploy-bot: status: success (15/15 warm requests) no OOMs observed in first 600s :rocket:

mira_ml: first 200 runs show no OOMs with warmup_entries=16 + prefetch_kv=false. quality looks close; will run full 2000 eval overnight. moving max_new_tokens default to 96 for now.

sam_infra: will monitor memory fragmentation metrics and run compaction cron on canary nodes overnight. if stable, we'll roll to canary2 and then small percentage traffic on prod.

tony_research: thanks. if regressions exceed 3% we'll revert and try hybrid quant (nf4) instead.

alex_dev: noted, creating a short runbook with mitigations (kv_shrink, reduce warmup, soft-throttle) and linking to this thread.

mira_ml: thanks all. follow-up tomorrow with eval numbers. :thumbsup:
